active_native_body.scope: Own weighted human authored from numerical profiles and own fictional skin-paint sources. Bounds CPU-skin the actual referenced displayed vertices. Third-party vendor bodies, faces, textures and animations are not loaded.
active_native_body.supplier: Sim2Seoul project-authored anatomy, facial sculpt, clothing, skeleton and weights; numerical materials plus own fictional image-generated skin paint

bones.scope: Actual rendered imported skeleton poses and parent distances, not hidden procedural proxy joint lengths. Native head/hip movement is recorded separately from the production camera eye.

captures.capture_method: Late-priority actual process observer then RenderingServer.force_draw; actual production W gait, no pose/phase assignment.

skin.scope: CPU skinning of referenced actual visible mesh vertices/bind poses. Buttock subset is fixed from neutral rendered surface within0.12m of actual pelvis rest height, lateral0.015..0.25m and actor-local rear z>0.015m. It can contain clothing. Normal finite test is linear-blend source normals, not GPU lighting/shading acceptance.
